## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Name the AI assistant or person who made it.

## Validation

Record actual checks and results; name checks not executed.
For UI changes attach responsive screenshots and asset review information.

## Documentation

Update the documents in this pull request, or write `Docs-Impact: none — <reason>`
on its own line in the description. CI checks this for product changes.

- [ ] docs/setup-status.md reflects the new state of `main`.
- [ ] docs/decisions.md records new, changed or superseded decisions.
- [ ] docs/assets.md lists every file added to or removed from `public/`.
- [ ] README.md, docs/mvp.md or AGENTS.md changed if scope, structure or rules changed.

## Review

- [ ] No scope expansion; reward/mastery/persistence rules preserved.
- [ ] Required checks passed on the current commit.
